description: The firm's notes: versioned annotations on contacts, journal entries, POs and invoices. op: get|put|update|query|scan. put/update append a version; get/query/scan return the latest.

op.description: get: latest by note_id. put: create. update: merge updates into the latest, new version. query: latest per note by one FK. scan: full table — prefer query or get.

note_id.description: get/update: required hash key. put: optional slug, generated if omitted.

content.description: put, required. Written as a template: $1, $2… where a name, an address or anything firm-specific goes, values in private_values in order. This field publishes; private_values never does.

private_values.description: put: what $1, $2… stand for, in order, one per placeholder. Never served; your own view puts them back.

updates.description: update, required: field to value (content, private_values, the FKs). Re-worded content re-states private_values — one value per $n or the write is refused.

contact_id.description: put: FK. query: notes about the contact.

journal_entry_id.description: put: FK. query: notes annotating the entry.

purchase_order_id.description: put: FK. query: notes about the PO.

invoice_id.description: put: FK. query: notes about the invoice.
